source_text: {In this chapter, we shall obtain efficiently implementable Galerkin subspaces of $H\Lambda^k$ by constructing them as spaces of finite elements. The desired degree of approximation will then be obtained by using a sufficiently fine mesh and/or sufficiently high degree piecewise polynomial shape functions. The challenge is to ensure that the spaces form a subcomplex admitting a bounded cochain projection.}
translated_text: {本章将通过构造有限元空间, 得到可高效实现的 $H\Lambda^k$ 的 Galerkin 子空间. 随后使用足够细的网格和/或足够高次的分片多项式形函数, 就能得到所需的逼近程度. 挑战在于保证这些空间构成具有有界上链投影的子复形.}

source_text: {The chapter is organized as follows. Before defining the complete and trimmed spaces $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ and $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ in Section~\ref{sec:finite-element-differential-forms}, we establish some properties of differential forms with polynomial coefficients in Sections~\ref{sec:complete-polynomial-forms}--\ref{sec:trimmed-polynomial-forms}. Then, in Section~\ref{sec:finite-element-space-properties}, we show how these spaces may be combined into complexes which fulfill the hypotheses required for the error analysis in Chapter~\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes}, thus establishing a full set of error bounds for our methods. In Section~\ref{sec:cubical-elements} we briefly describe analogous results for finite elements based on meshes of boxes rather than simplices. Finally, in Section~\ref{sec:historical-antecedents}, we relate the elements described in this chapter to various finite elements in the literature.}
translated_text: {本章安排如下. 在 Section~\ref{sec:finite-element-differential-forms} 定义完全空间和修剪空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ 与 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ 之前, 先在 Section~\ref{sec:complete-polynomial-forms}--\ref{sec:trimmed-polynomial-forms} 建立多项式系数微分形式的一些性质. 随后在 Section~\ref{sec:finite-element-space-properties}, 说明如何将这些空间组合为满足 Chapter~\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes} 误差分析所需假设的复形, 从而为我们的方法建立完整的误差界. 在 Section~\ref{sec:cubical-elements}, 简要说明基于长方体网格而非单纯形网格的有限元的类似结果. 最后在 Section~\ref{sec:historical-antecedents}, 将本章描述的单元与文献中的各种有限元联系起来.}

source_text: {Before proceeding, we make a brief remark on notation. The finite element spaces $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ and $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ which we will define in the next section consist of piecewise polynomial differential $k$-forms defined over the domain $\Omega$. We will give a unified construction of the spaces, but each space depends on the polynomial degree $r\geq0$, the form degree $k$ between $0$ and $n=\dim\Omega$, and the simplicial mesh $\mathcal T_h$. We shall also use the notation $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ and $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k$ for the spaces of complete and trimmed polynomial (not piecewise polynomial) differential $k$-forms of degree $r$ that are used on each simplex to construct the finite element spaces. These spaces of polynomials are defined for each $n$ and for each $r\geq0$ and $0\leq k\leq n$. Finally, we write $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(T)$ and $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(T)$ for the spaces of restrictions of these polynomials to a single simplex $T$. Thus our notation is analogous to a common notation for standard Lagrange finite elements of degree $r$: $\mathcal P_r(\mathcal T_h)$ for the finite element space, $\mathcal P_r$ for the space of polynomials of degree $r$, and $\mathcal P_r(T)$ for their restriction to an element.}
translated_text: {继续之前, 简要说明记号. 下一节将定义的有限元空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ 和 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$, 由定义在区域 $\Omega$ 上的分片多项式微分 $k$-形式构成. 将对这些空间给出统一构造, 但每个空间都依赖于多项式次数 $r\geq0$, 介于 $0$ 与 $n=\dim\Omega$ 之间的形式次数 $k$, 以及单纯网格 $\mathcal T_h$. 还将用记号 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ 和 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k$ 表示次数为 $r$ 的完全和修剪多项式 (而非分片多项式) 微分 $k$-形式空间, 它们用于在每个单纯形上构造有限元空间. 这些多项式空间对每个 $n$, 每个 $r\geq0$ 及 $0\leq k\leq n$ 都有定义. 最后, 用 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(T)$ 和 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(T)$ 表示这些多项式限制在单个单纯形 $T$ 上的空间. 因此, 此记号类似于次数为 $r$ 的标准 Lagrange 有限元常用记号: $\mathcal P_r(\mathcal T_h)$ 表示有限元空间, $\mathcal P_r$ 表示次数为 $r$ 的多项式空间, $\mathcal P_r(T)$ 表示它们在一个单元上的限制.}
